subject: Post-call recap: procurement gates, PO vs card & proposed timeline
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.inference>
To: Anna Myers <anna@edgehealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-14T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement gates, PO vs card & proposed timeline

Hi Anna — thanks for the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan so we can get procurement moving on your side.

Call highlights:
- EdgeHealth prefers predictable pricing and isolation for PHI-sensitive workloads — we covered Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private.
- Procurement path looks like: Legal review -> Security questionnaire & evidence -> Finance PO issuance (card option low preference) -> Provisioning.
- Marketplace (vendor catalog) is interesting to you, but likely a follow-on after initial pilot.

Proposed immediate next steps (action items):
1) I will share a draft MPA + SOW for your legal to review (attached: redwood-mpa-draft-20261014.pdf).
2) Please confirm expected timelines from each gate (legal / security / finance). You mentioned legal typically takes ~7–12 business days; we captured that but want firm owners.
3) Security will need a completed questionnaire — I attached a vendor checklist and can route our standard security packet.
4) Finance: confirm whether PO issuance is required for pilot; if so, who will own the PO and what is the billing contact.

If this looks right, can you: (a) confirm owners for legal/security/finance and (b) indicate a target PO issuance week?

Attachments: redwood-mpa-draft-20261014.pdf

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0123

---

From: Anna Myers <anna@edgehealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@edgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement gates, PO vs card & proposed timeline

Thanks Mateo — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Legal: I own the intake for this but will route to our contracts counsel; typical turnaround is 10 business days unless there are major redlines.
- Security: we require our standard vendor security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence; will need the questionnaire back to start the review.
- Finance: our default is PO for anything above $50k ARR; for pilot budgets < $50k we sometimes accept card but prefer PO to keep procurement tracked. Finance wants invoice-level fields (bill-to, remit-to, W-9).

We are interested in marketplace listing but prioritize getting MPA in place first for the pilot.

I attached a short procurement intake form (procurement_intake.pdf) with current owners filled in.

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-16T10:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement gates, PO vs card & proposed timeline

Mateo — looping in to map internal gate owners and set expectations. My suggestions:
- Legal: assign to contracts@redwood.inference (priority routing, 5–8 business days unless redlines)
- Security: send our vendor-security-packet + SOC2 link; we can fast-track a short questionnaire for pilot scopes (~3 business days to review if evidence present)
- Finance: request billing contact details and target PO amount; finance ops can reserve a PO template for EdgeHealth.

I’ll prepare a Gantt-style timeline matrix with owners and send by EOD tomorrow.

- Vanessa
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.inference>
To: Anna Myers <anna@edgehealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-18T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Updated MAP & timeline (Gantt) + checklist attached

Anna — attached is the Gantt-style mutual action plan and the vendor checklist (vendor-checklist-edgehealth.xlsx). Quick summary of proposed dates we discussed: 

Milestones (proposed)
- 2026-10-18: Redwood shares final MPA + SOW (done)
- 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-29: Legal review window (EdgeHealth counsel)
- 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-26: Security questionnaire & evidence (concurrent)
- 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-05: Finance review & PO issuance
- Provisioning target: 2026-11-06 (soft)

Notes / asks:
- If legal needs additional time, please flag immediately so we can arrange a targeted legal exception for pilot access.
- We will keep marketplace listing as a separate track post-pilot; not required for initial provisioning.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-mpa-edgehealth (Gantt and supporting docs)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/RDW-8743

Attachments: vendor-checklist-edgehealth.xlsx

Thanks —
Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

From: Olivia Reiss <oreiss@edgehealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.inference>, Anna Myers <anna@edgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP & timeline (Gantt) + checklist attached

Hi all — finance here. We reviewed the proposed timeline and can target PO issuance the week of 2026-10-30 provided the legal sign-off and an invoice-ready MPA. Please confirm these invoice fields so we can draft the PO:
- Bill-to name and address
- Remit-to (wiring instructions or card processor)
- Tax ID / W-9

Also confirm whether EdgeHealth will accept staged invoicing or a single invoice for the pilot term.

If you send the final MPA with those fields filled we will slot this into our PO queue and aim for issuance by 2026-11-03.

Best,
Olivia Reiss
Senior Manager, Finance Operations
EdgeHealth
